title: Puerto Rican room. Free breakfast/pool/wifi/Nature
propertyType: Private room in bed and breakfast
description: Welcome to La Casa Azul B&B. Our Casona is located on the west coast of Puerto Rico; between the towns of Aguada and Rincón.This is one of the five cozy private rooms in our guesthouse. You will enjoy our pool, local breakfast included, private forest and our cocoa crop where we give the Cocoa Tour. Just minutes away you will find the best beaches and tourist attractions in the region.We want you to live like a Boricua!The spaceAt Casa Azul, we want you to experience the island in Boricua style! Our private room is spacious, comfortable and has everything you need for a great stay. Our 1950 house is decorated with local rustic touches that give it a Creole style, typical of Caribbean cottages.We want you to feel at home at your grandmother's house in Puerto Rico. The private room has air conditioning, a private bathroom, a refrigerator, a TV, a safe, a luggage rack, a comfortable closet, towels, sheets, and toiletries.In the common areas we have a large terrace, balconies with chairs, hammocks and tables where you can have breakfast, read a book or just relax.In our living room we have a variety of board games, a smart TV with built-in WiFi and local channels, comfortable armchairs and Creole chairs that give it a cultural touch. We have an information table where you will find information and brochures about the best restaurants, beaches, museums, and all the places to visit near us.The dining room has a large table and an island-bar.The kitchen is fully equipped with a stove, sink, microwave, coffee maker, fridge, and all the necessary utensils so you can prepare your own meals before or after exploring.Our breakfast is light and varied, Continental style. We always have coffee, juice, bread, jellies, hams, cereal, milk, and a variety of fruits so you can start your day well. In the garden we have an excellent shared pool area. You'll see our little square with chairs, tables, and umbrellas. We have three gazebos, one of them with a grill. There is a shower area and pool bathroom.Our private forest is the perfect place to be in touch with nature. You can explore the different trails while discovering our nature. You'll see hammocks throughout the forest, a campfire area, and fish ponds. In the forest you can observe birds, connect with nature and do yoga.Inside the forest is our cocoa crop that produces the material to make our chocolate bars.Stay with us and Live the Boricua Life!Guest accessThe house has high-speed WiFi; perfect for watching Netflix on our smart TV, studying or working.We provide towels, toiletries, toilet paper, and garbage bags. If you need more of these resources during your stay, please ask.The room is equipped with three comfortable queen-size beds and two twin beds, a private bathroom, a refrigerator, a smart TV, air conditioning, a closet, a safe, and a luggage rack. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the utensils so you can cook your favorite dishes. We always have coffee and tea available to our guests in the house.Breakfast is included in the rate. It is local, varied and perfect to start your morning right. It consists of cereals, toast, a variety of fruits, hams, cheeses, jellies, coffee, juice, tortillas. In the courtyard there are three comfortable gazebos, a grill and a campfire area in our forest. We have all the equipment for barbecuing except charcoal. This must be purchased by guests. There is a ramp for the disabled in the house that gives access to our second level and the pool area.The pool area has a variety of tables and chairs. It has spaces to put your towel and take a delicious sunbath. It also has its shower and bathroom area. It can be used at any time.In the living room, you will find an information table with lists of museums, parks, taxis, forests, agrotours, beaches, restaurants, and all the places to visit near Casa Azul.We are in an excellent location between the towns of Aguada, Rincon, and Aguadilla. That's why we're the perfect place for surfers and adventurers who like to explore our island.The beaches of all the towns in the northwest are very close to us. Drive between 6 and 15 minutes and you'll find very good paradisiacal beaches.Our Cocoa Tour lasts one hour and the time is coordinated with us to offer it during the stay.Tour hours are Monday through Friday from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM and weekends from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM.Ask us about our variety of private tours exploring Aguada and other western villages.We also have free private parking inside our house.During your stayCheck-in is from 4:00 PM onwards. We like to personally greet our guests to welcome them, give them a tour of the facilities, answer questions, and give them the access keys.We also have the option to send you the instructions for independent access to the house by message or email in case you arrive late at night. We are available to answer any questions about the house or places to explore and visit in our area. So please don't hesitate to reach out or call.Don't forget to ask us about our Cocoa tour and our variety of cultural tours through the villages of Aguada, Rincon, and Aguadilla.I'm a tour guide and historian. Ask about the availability to visit our antique collections that include art, carvings, antique objects, and historical documents from Puerto Rico.Come and live the Casa Azul Experience!Other things to noteExperiences at Casa Azul.We have a variety of activities that you can do in coordination with us that will make your stay unique and fun.Cocoa Tour.At our house, we grow cocoa where we produce handmade chocolate.The Cocoa tour lasts one hour.The schedule is coordinated directly with you during your stay. Cost: $15 per person.We learn about the history, cultivation, and processing of cocoa and include a tasting of our handmade chocolate.Visit our private museum.I am a certified tour guide and historian, and as part of our offer we have a visit to our private museum.The visit lasts 35 minutes and includes a tour of 5 rooms of antiques, art, and carvings that tell the story of the towns of western Puerto Rico.Cost: $5 per person.Tour of Aguada.The tour lasts 2 hours.We explore some of the iconic places of Aguada Town as we stroll through the historic center. Cost: $20 per person.Casa Azul Rules.Each space has a maximum number of guests. Additional guests who are not notified will be charged an additional $25 per person per night.Smoking is not allowed inside the house or in the rooms. We have a for smokers outside. Smoking inside the house will result in a $100 cleaning fee to remove the odor.No pets allowed on the property, except for service animals.If you bring pets, a $35 pet fee will apply.We have a water tank and electric generator in the house for your comfort.The pool can be used at any time. Please do not eat or drink in the pool.Do not run or dive in the pool.In the pool area there is an outdoor shower that can be used to wash off sand if you come from the beach.Check-in will always be at 4:00 PM. If you need to arrive earlier, you must notify us in advance and it will be subject to the availability of your space.Late check-out.Check-out is at 12:00 noon or earlier.Late check-out must be notified in advance and is subject to space availability.An additional fee of $15 will be charged for each additional hour after 12:00 noon.The house is exclusively for guests. No outsiders or visitors other than Casa Azul guests or employees are allowed inside Casa Azul premises.Loud noises, screams, and loud music are prohibited at night. This is for the benefit of all guests and the community.If you're going to use our fire pit area or use the grill, remember to turn it off after use and throw the ashes in the nearest trash can. Guests must buy charcoal.Only Casa Azul guests can use the pool area.Our staff is always ready to help.
